Claim 281 (Currently amended): A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer, each located on opposite sides of a medial section; and an additional adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, and wherein the additional adhesive layer is positioned between the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

Claim 282 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

Claim 283 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

Claim 284 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section is a composite material.

Claim 285 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

Claim 286 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

Claim 287 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, further including a plurality of cutting segments welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

Claim 288 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is continuous. 

Claim 290 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

Claim 291 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes a central opening.

Claim 293 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments.

Claim 294 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous.
